title: Take Logarithms
text:
From $2 = (1.105)^n$

Take log of both sides:
$\log 2 = n \log(1.105)$

$n = \frac{\log 2}{\log 1.105}$

title: Calculate
text:
$n = \frac{\log 2}{\log 1.105} = \frac{0.30103}{0.04336} = 6.94$ years

It will take approximately 6.94 years (or about 7 years) for the investment to double.
